Subject: Re: Promo-pack samples — small insert size mismatch / alternate option

Hi Mina,

Quick update from production: the poly-envelope we quoted for the 3-pocket insert is slightly narrower than the sample you sent, so the die-line for Pocket B (the fold-out inserts) now hits the seam. We can either: 1) reduce Pocket B width by 8mm (minor layout tweak, no cost), or 2) print a new envelope dieline and re-run tooling (2-3 business days + $420 tooling).

Option 1 changes the printable area but keeps copy and order quantities identical. If you want us to proceed with option 1 we will update the proof and hold shipment until you sign off. If you want tooling re-run we'll need explicit approval and a final PO change.

Attached: RW-promo-pack-proof-v3.pdf (mockup with alternate Pocket B), color swatches.

Also, one of the special lanyard batches is backordered — ETA 5/14 — that will affect 1.2k of the 6k total packs. We can split-kitting: ship 4.8k packs to the warehouse for event drop, and hold 1.2k until the lanyards arrive and then do a second kitting run. Shipping cost difference approx $260.

Please advise how you'd like us to proceed.

Thanks,
Tanya
Account Manager | PrintWell Co.
